items.title: Perceptual colour geometry
items.evidence: Existing IPT/Oklab/JzAzBz/CAM16-UCS/Hellwig/opponent comparisons; signed production extension explicitly ours.
items.gap: Hue-linearized CIELAB/Lissner reproductions and constant-perceived-hue data; Hellwig HK Density experiments incomplete.
items.next_action: Retain signed Oklab candidate; target blue/cyan failure evidence before changing it.

items.title: Geometry validation
items.evidence: Coordinate round trips/domain diagnostics, structured hue/EV/neutral/skin/HDR targets and family/EV baseline errors.
items.gap: Reference perceived-hue trajectories, local metric distortion and family-specific conditioning are incomplete.
items.next_action: Extend diagnostics when artist comparison exposes geometry drift.

items.title: Continuous volume deformation
items.evidence: Continuous six-family engine; original-source selections; four accumulation modes and permutation tests.
items.next_action: Retain normalized original-source delta model; do not substitute untested mathematics.

items.title: Jacobian analysis
items.evidence: Continuity/overlap tests exist, but are not a Jacobian study.
items.gap: No determinant/SVD/condition maps, folding report or Inspector Jacobian mode.
items.next_action: Engineering follow-up: structured central differences with step-convergence checks; explicit supported-domain fold report.

items.title: Monotone curves
items.evidence: Analytical smooth Tone and continuous crossover; monotone PCHIP used for M17 baseline curves.
items.gap: Full five-family interpolation comparison and exhaustive parameter-domain monotonicity proof incomplete.
items.next_action: Investigate observed reversal or overshoot; PCHIP is a baseline, not an automatic replacement.

items.title: Distribution mapping / OT
items.evidence: M16 uses palette quantiles/covariance diagnostically; this is not optimal transport.
items.next_action: Keep outside production; add only for a specific palette-analysis failure.

items.title: Gradient / structure preservation
items.evidence: Pointwise CPU models and real-media contact sheets exist.
items.next_action: Targeted offline diagnostics when spatial destruction is identified; do not make Volume spatial.

items.title: Spatial tone / Pigment
items.evidence: Pointwise Tone remains separate; no spatial logic silently merged.
items.gap: Reinhard/Fattal/WLS/local-Laplacian Pigment comparison is future work.
items.next_action: Separate future Pigment scope, no v1 expansion.

items.title: Spectral / material mathematics
items.evidence: Spectral Lab integration/reconstruction/KM/Beer-Lambert/Neugebauer oracle and fit reports retained.
items.gap: Jakob-Hanika reconstruction and Pigmento/print-model reproduction comparison incomplete.
items.next_action: Use accepted existing trajectories; target additions to concrete Density/Strip failures.

items.title: Soft palette / layer geometry
items.gap: Image-aware optimization, hull/RGBXY soft layers absent.

items.title: Density formulation / HK
items.evidence: Material depth, separate chroma coupling, protection, signed/HDR adapter and M17 baselines.
items.gap: Equal-luminance unequal-chroma perceived-brightness compensation experiments absent; no artist acceptance.
items.next_action: Density stays research; test HK only to resolve a repeatable density-vs-darkness deficiency.

items.title: Continuous crossover
items.evidence: Continuous hue/EV opponent trajectories and smooth transitions; hard keys are comparison diagnostics only.
items.gap: Dedicated trajectory plots and complete C1 parameter-boundary validation remain.
items.next_action: Retain continuous candidate; evaluate cyan trajectory and threshold seams visually.

items.title: Strip formulation
items.evidence: Separation/nonlinear dye response/leakage/recombination; held-out spectral fits; matrix and matrix+PCHIP baselines now compared.
items.gap: Complete tetrahedral/LUT and Neugebauer creative comparison absent; meaningful artist superiority unproved.
items.next_action: Strip remains research. Simple baseline equivalence is grounds to simplify, not a failed marketing story.

items.title: Diagnostic metrics
items.evidence: Conversion/CAT, neutral, exposure, spectral and held-out trajectory errors; family/EV relative errors.
items.gap: Jacobian/palette OT/perceived-hue and full appearance-distance reports incomplete.
items.next_action: No scalar metric grants acceptance; add metrics relevant to recorded visual deficiencies.

items.title: Artist target suite
items.evidence: Six target recipes on structured and synthetic CG plus six user-approved ACES photographic/CG frames, fixed Flawed Emulsion 2 view.
items.gap: Human evaluation of usefulness, coherence, all desired skin/black/contamination variants and continuity pending.
items.next_action: Immediate artist session using editable graph and feedback form.

items.title: Reference reconstruction
items.evidence: Five approved independent sample-frame references; bounded fits using only existing rendition nodes plus fixed user DRT; recipes reused on second content.
items.gap: Palette-descriptor fitting cannot establish visual-language reconstruction; human interaction time and reusable look-grammar judgement pending.
items.next_action: Review references/candidates in Nuke; record controls, time, failures and reuse. Do not equate solver time with artist time.

items.title: Simplicity challenge
items.evidence: Density vs exposure+saturation (also matched selection), Strip vs matrix+monotone curves, Volume vs hue curves, Crossover vs smooth/hard luminance keys; held-out errors and visual comparisons.
items.gap: Limited fit settings/distribution; signed/HDR/compositing baseline stress and human interaction/superiority judgements incomplete.
items.next_action: Artist A/B now; Density/Strip cannot receive production status from numerical differences.

items.title: Research stop rule
items.evidence: Gap audit preserves models; broad literature expansion stopped; implementation/visual comparison/artist feedback become primary.
items.gap: Future targeted research must cite a specific unresolved property or repeatable failure.
items.next_action: Require an issue with stimulus, expected/observed behaviour, gate and evidence before adding literature.
